<thought>Since the search for a Diels‑Alder template returned no results with the previous criteria, I will broaden the search. A Diels‑Alder reaction involves the conversion of two C=C double bonds into two C–C single bonds, i.e., the bond order changes from double to single for two bonds and two new C–C bonds are formed. I will search the template catalog for any template that has at least one C=C bond order change and forms C–C single bonds.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
  "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"]
}
</action_input>
